spells.desc: A terracotta rank rises from the floor and marches as a wedge, shoving enemies while each soldier lands one heavy spear thrust.

spells.name: Paper Crane Chorus
spells.desc: Folded paper cranes lift from the sleeve, choose their own targets, and return a trickle of vitality as they cut past.

spells.name: Lotus Reversal
spells.desc: A lotus mirror blooms around the caster, catching hostile shots and turning each catch into a soft petal counterburst.
